## Summary

Describe the change and user-visible result.

## Validation

- [ ] Unreal Engine version and target platform recorded
- [ ] Relevant automation tests run
- [ ] Representative `.frag` import checked
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Third-party notices preserved
- [ ] Commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line

## Performance and compatibility

Describe frame-time, memory, import-time, threading, or API compatibility
impact. Mention changes to defaults or console variables.
